rule.flagged: At least one M1 finding with confidence observed or reviewed, excluding failed_call findings whose cause is gateway refusal, scope or budget (keep rule v2).
rule.grounded: A completed get_context call precedes the first call to a tool outside the non-edit set, or the run makes no edit call.
rule.verified: A completed capture_viewport call whose metadata text block is reflected in a later agent message or tool argument (key name, bounding-box or camera number, or object count with its noun), or a reviewed judgment with a quoted trace excerpt.
